id: \bWhat the? How did you get here?
en: \bWhat the? How did you get here?

id: \bSo a Tapu Koko brought you to my world. It must have been from an overlap from the electrical energy between your Tapu and mine.
en: \bSo a Tapu Koko brought you to my world. It must have been from an overlap from the electrical energy between your Tapu and mine.
it: \bQuindi è stato un Tapu Koko a portarti nel mio mondo. Dev'essere successo per una sovrapposizione tra l'energia elettrica del tuo Tapu e quella del mio.

id: \bThere's a Guzzlord that's been terrorizing the area. If you can defeat it, it just might encourage Tapu Koko to send you back.
en: \bThere's a Guzzlord that's been terrorizing the area.  If you can defeat it, it just might encourage Tapu Koko to send you back.
it: \bC'è un Guzzlord che terrorizza la zona.  Se riesci a sconfiggerlo, magari convincerai Tapu Koko a rimandarti indietro.
